title: Storm Boy
tagline: A boy, a pelican and the Coorong.
about: A boy living with his reclusive dad on the wild South Australian coast raises an orphaned pelican called Mr Percival.
cue: Serve the fish when Hideaway Tom brings in the catch.
faces: Mr Percival has his fish. You've got your bread. Eat up, then watch the sand dunes.
Hollow crusted damper with butter, golden syrup and lemon myrtle salt.
Pipis steamed open in garlic, chilli, lemon butter, with crusty bread.
Mr Percival would have eaten these whole.
Hideaway Tom's crisp fish and chips
Battered white fish with chicken salt chips and homemade tartare.
